items.title: Paul Eddy Saint-Vilien appointed as head coach of Stingers football
items.excerpt: Claude Morin, in his first full year as Director of Concordia Recreation and Athletics, has now elected to remain in-house for both varsity program coaching hires made this season.
items.body: Claude Morin, in his first full year as Director of Concordia Recreation and Athletics, has now elected to remain in-house for both varsity program coaching hires made this season. The decision to remove the interim tag from Saint-Vilien’s title comes a few months after a similar decision was made for Damian Buckley’s position as head coach of Concordia men’s varsity basketball. The decision comes ahead of Dec. 1, which Saint-Vilien had asked Stingers’ leadership for, given its importance for recruitment amid provincial championships at the CEGEP level.
items.resume: Claude Morin, directeur de Concordia Recreation and Athletics, a choisi de maintenir Paul Eddy Saint-Vilien comme entraîneur-chef des Stingers de football. Cette décision fait suite à une décision similaire concernant Damian Buckley, entraîneur-chef de l'équipe de basketball masculin de Concordia. La décision a été prise avant le 1er décembre, une date importante pour le recrutement en raison des championnats provinciaux au niveau CEGEP.
